title: EURUSD M30 Soft Lot Filter Deactivation Test
research_question: Does deactivating soft lot throttling (InpUseH4Soft=false and InpUseAdxSoft=false) increase total net profit on EURUSD M30 while maintaining maximal equity drawdown <= 6.0% across both 2020-2024 training and 2025 validation partitions?
hypothesis: Because EURUSD M30 exhibits high entry precision (74.5%-75.0% win rate), deactivating secondary soft lot throttling will allow winning trades to capture full 1.0% risk payoffs, increasing total net profit above baseline EXP-0026 (+$530.14) and EXP-0027 (+$535.68) without breaching prop firm drawdown thresholds.

facts: EXP-0026 on EURUSD M30 with throttled lots achieved +$530.14 net profit and 4.31% max drawdown in training (2020-2024).
EXP-0027 on EURUSD M30 with throttled lots achieved +$535.68 net profit, 74.55% win rate, and 5.12% max drawdown in validation (2025).
On GBPUSD M30 (EXP-0034/EXP-0035), deactivating soft lot filters increased 2025 net profit by +26.1% (from $505 to $637) while holding drawdown virtually flat (3.93%).
EURUSD shares European session liquidity with GBPUSD and has demonstrated parallel structural behavior.
inferences: Deactivating soft lot throttling on EURUSD will eliminate the 0.6x and 0.3x lot penalties on winning setups.
Given the 74.5%+ win rate on EURUSD, full 1.0% risk payouts will expand net dollar returns while keeping equity drawdown safely below 6.0%.
evidence: EXP-0026 total_trades=24, profit_factor=1.84, win_rate=75.00%, total_net_profit=530.14, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=4.31
EXP-0027 total_trades=55, profit_factor=1.62, win_rate=74.55%, total_net_profit=535.68, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=5.12
EXP-0035 total_trades=25, profit_factor=2.29, win_rate=80.00%, total_net_profit=637.23, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=3.93

independent_variables.name: InpUseH4Soft
independent_variables.rationale: Disable H4 counter-trend lot reduction to allow full 1.0% risk sizing on EURUSD.

independent_variables.name: InpUseAdxSoft
independent_variables.rationale: Disable ADX momentum lot reduction to allow full 1.0% risk sizing on EURUSD.

assumptions: EURUSD market dynamics respond similarly to GBPUSD under unthrottled lot sizing.
Drawdown guards (4% daily, 8% total) will protect capital if full-sized losses cluster.
expected_observations: Total net profit exceeds baseline EXP-0026 (+$530.14) in training and EXP-0027 (+$535.68) in validation.
falsification_conditions: Total net profit decreases or fails to meaningfully improve relative to baseline.
